# The Kala Culture Tattoos

> Tattoo artist, tattoo shop and tattoo studio on Vasna-Bhayli Main Road, Vadodara (Baroda), Gujarat, India. Lead artist: Jaimin Parmar. Custom, realism, fine line, colour, cover-up and matching tattoos, plus a tattoo training academy.

Address: 102, Neelkanth Gold Complex, Vasna-Bhayli Main Rd, Vadodara, Gujarat 390020
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9157714414
Hours: Monday to Sunday, 11 AM to 10 PM
